inclusion_rule: Include studies that train a decoder or synthesizer on silently articulated (mimed, mouthed) non-acoustic signals using acoustic or label targets transferred from a separate vocalized recording of the same utterance by time alignment (DTW, forced alignment or a learned alignment). Any signal qualifies. Boundary: exclude studies that train only on vocalized data and test on silent data (M04 overt-to-silent transfer), alignment used only to score outputs, whisper or NAM acoustic conversion, and imagined speech; count versions once.
